- No action required: Existing API calls to gemini-3.5-flash are  
automatically routed to gemini-3.6-flash. No immediate code changes are  
required to maintain uptime.

- Pricing: Gemini 3.6 Flash is available at the same $1.50 / 1M input token

promotional discount of 50% which brings down the cost to $0.75 / 1M input  
and $3.75 output, so you will see a decrease in billing assuming the same  
amount of tokens.

service disruptions.
